SUMMARY: The National Weather Service has issued a Gale Watch for the coastal waters of New Hampshire and Maine from late Thursday evening through Friday. The Captain of the Port of Coast Guard Sector Northern New England is urging the maritime public to exercise caution when considering operation in adverse weather conditions. Maritime stakeholders should review continuity of operations and communication procedures, as well as methods of minimizing storm damage and environmental risk, such as riding out the storm at sea, doubling up mooring lines, securing transfers, ballasting down storage tanks and draining transfer lines.
